mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 35 degrees, under the light of a Waning Gibbous moon.

All four Aldermanic districts in Verona will have seats on the ballot for the 2027 Spring Election. Candidates should visit the City Clerk's office at 111 Lincoln Street to pick up their information packets, which must be submitted by 5:00 p.m. on January 5, 2027.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Paddy Mac's, along with the Crafty Fair at ART House 360. Tomorrow, you can catch more live music at the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Looking at the recent police activity, on November 2, officers were dispatched to the 100 block of West End Circle regarding a domestic disturbance, resulting in the arrest of a 48-year-old man.
Stop by today to enjoy the delicious Mint Cookie flavor of the day; the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
